notes: CameraController.attachRuntime only reads config, sets world bounds and applies bootstrap camera once (this.ready=true); it acquires no listener or resource, and input teardown is handled by destroy(), so no detachRuntime is needed.

The inverse exists and is used: disableInteractive/restoreInteractiveTarget are invoked in InteractionModule.ts and EntityVisualInstanceRuntime.ts to undo the setInteractive done by bindInteractiveCircle.

registerPreBehaviorSystem pushes into a container-owned array in RuntimeSystemsRegistry; systems are registered once at runtime construction and live for the runtime lifetime, so no unregister is required.
The inverse exists: ImpulseEngine.removeBody mirrors addBody and is called on kill/reset/transfer paths (KillHandler, runtimeReset, ResolveTransferHandler).
registerOperations is an idempotent one-time global JsonLogic registration guarded by opsRegistered; these are process-global singleton ops with no teardown semantics.
registerSystem pushes into RuntimeSystemsRegistry.registeredSystems, a container-owned array populated once for the runtime lifetime with no dynamic removal, so no unregister inverse is needed.
The inverse exists: hideDistressHalos calls tweens.killTweensOf and hides the halos, and DistressModule.ts uses it to stop the burst started by startDistressBurst.
beginPinch produces transient pinch state that is cleared by setState({ pinch: null }) in the pointer-up handler of cameraControllerBindings.ts, closing the lifecycle.
addDemandEdges appends edges to a locally-built VeinGraph buffer that is rebuilt each call; it is data construction, not resource acquisition, so no removeEdge inverse applies.
addSinkDemandEdge pushes into the transient VeinGraph buffer via pushVeinEdge; the graph is a return value rebuilt from scratch, so there is no lifecycle to reverse.
addDemandRoute only appends nodes/edges to the in-memory VeinGraph being constructed; it is a pure builder step with no persistent state to release.
addDirectIds pushes ids into a RuntimeInvalidationSummary accumulator built per command; it is transient aggregation with no inverse remove semantics.
addWorldEdge/addNervousEdges append to the locally-constructed VeinGraph buffer that is rebuilt each build pass, so no edge-removal inverse is needed.
addSinkEdges appends sink edges to the transient VeinGraph buffer; it constructs a fresh return value rather than mutating persistent state, so a mirror is inapplicable.
addWorldRoute appends world/nervous edges into the in-memory graph buffer during construction; there is no retained resource requiring a remove.
addId pushes a string into summary.changedEntityIds, a per-command accumulator array; it is transient collection-building with no meaningful inverse.
addNode sets a node into the graphBuffer.nodes Map being assembled and returned; the map is rebuilt wholesale each call, so no removeNode inverse is required.
addWorldRoute for route-world edges only appends to the transient VeinGraph buffer during graph construction, with no persistent registration to reverse.
